unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. (1) 计算；(2) 预测；推测
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you calculate how much money we need for the trip?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你能算一下我们这次旅行需要多少钱吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: calcul(小石头，古人用来计数的石子) + -ate(动词后缀) -> 计数，计算。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Students are allowed to use a scientific calculator in the math exam.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 学生在数学考试中被允许使用科学计算器。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: v. calculate(计算) + -or(工具名词后缀) -> 计算工具 -> 计算器。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Because of the heavy rain, the sports meeting had to be cancelled.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 由于大雨，运动会不得不取消了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 字面联想：打叉(×)代表取消 -> cancel 取消。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: But I lose one leg because of cancer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: can(能够)+cer(策)：能够用策略去战胜癌症(cancer)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The Grand Canyon in the United States is one of the natural wonders of the world.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 美国的科罗拉多大峡谷是世界自然奇观之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：can(能) + yon(远处) -> 能看到远处深谷 -> 峡谷。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The team captain had to leave because of heart problems.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：cap (头) + tain (持，握) -> 团队的头目，即队长。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. (1) 捕获；俘获；(2) 体现出；描绘出；(3) 采集 n. (1) (被)捕获；抓获；(2) 被捕获的人(或物)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The photographer managed to capture the beautiful moment of the bird flying.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 摄影师成功捕捉到了小鸟飞翔的美丽瞬间。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: cap(抓，拿) + -ture(名词/动词后缀) -> 抓住，捕获。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. (1) 职业；生涯；(2) 事业
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She decided to start a teaching career after graduating from university.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她大学毕业后决定开始教育职业生涯。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“客车儿” -> 在人生道路上一辆载着梦想飞驰的客车 -> 职业，生涯。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The old prince and princess rode in a golden carriage.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 老王子和公主坐在一辆金色的四轮马车里。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: car(车) + -riage(名词后缀) -> 马车，车厢。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: All students stood up to sing the national anthem at the opening ceremony.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在开幕式上，全体学生起立高唱国歌。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: c(看) + ere(在此) + mony(钱) -> 举行仪式要花钱看 -> 典礼，仪式。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Going from junior high school to senior high school is a really big challenge.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：车轮（chal-lenge谐音）挑战崎岖的山路。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Two weeks later, they were world champions!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：champ (啃，咬) + ion -> 咬牙坚持到底的就是冠军。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 人物；角色；(2) 文字；符号；(3) 性格；特征
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Who are the characters?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: char (茶) + act (演) + er -> 喝着茶演角色的人

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 特点；特性；特色 adj. 典型的，特有的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Patience is a key characteristic of a good teacher.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 耐心是一个好老师的关键特征。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: character(性格、特征) + -istic(形容词/名词后缀) -> 典型的，特点。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 收费 n. (1) 费用，价钱；(2) 将(电池)充电；(3) 指责，责备；(4) 主管，责任
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember to charge your mobile phone before going out.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 出门前记得给你的手机充电。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“恰只” -> 吃饭要恰只费用 / 充电要恰只电量 -> 收费/充电/责任。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 慈善，施舍；慈善机构
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We raised a lot of money for the local charity to help homeless people.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们为当地的慈善机构筹集了许多资金以帮助无家可归的人。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: char-(心好) + -ity(名词后缀) -> 心肠好、爱心行为 -> 慈善。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 欺诈，作假；作弊(在考试等中) `n.` (1) 作弊者(在游戏或考试中)，舞弊者；(2) 欺骗手段；欺诈行为
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should not cheat in any sports game.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：买到便宜货 (cheap) 往往是被商家欺骗 (cheat) 了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 化学的；含有化学物质的；化学作用的 n. 化学品；化学制品
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should wear safety glasses when doing chemical experiments in the lab.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们在实验室做化学实验时应该戴上安全眼镜。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: chem(化学) + -ical(形容词/名词后缀) -> 化学的，化学品。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 首领，头目 `adj.` 主要的，首要的；首席的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dr Lu Xingyuan is chief researcher of the centre.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ch + ief -> 队伍里最重要的首领或首席。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The children had great fun making lovely animals out of clay in art class.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孩子们在美术课上用黏土捏出可爱的小动物，玩得很开心。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：c(看) + lay(放置) -> 把土放在地上揉捏 -> 黏土，陶土。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Smoking cigarettes is harmful to your health and lungs.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 吸烟对你的健康和肺部有害。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: cigar(雪茄) + -ette(小后缀，表示小) -> 小雪茄 -> 香烟。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every citizen has the duty to obey the law and protect the environment.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 每个公民都有遵守法律和保护环境的责任。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: city(城市) + -zen(人) -> 城市里的人 -> 公民，居民。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 典型的 `n.` 经典作品，杰作
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People in modern times can read the classic works which were written by Chinese in ancient times.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：class（班级、等级）+ -ic（形容词后缀）→ 有等级的，一流 of → 经典的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 经典的，古典的；传统的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Listening to classical music can help you relax after a busy day.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 听古典音乐可以帮你在忙碌的一天后放松下来。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: classic(经典) + -al(形容词后缀) -> 古典的，经典的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Chores can be fun!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ch(吃)+ore(矿石) -> 每天吃力地搬运矿石，像做繁重的家务杂务(chore)一样。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The hotel clerk smiled politely and handed me the room key.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 酒店职员礼貌地微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：车(car) + lock(锁) -> 负责管钥匙和记录的办事员 -> 职员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Because of this, they are popular subjects in studies on climate change and the ecosystem.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 同班同学 (classmate) 们在一起讨论气候 (climate) 变化。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If you only have a slight cough, you can go to the community clinic nearby.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 如果你只是有点轻微咳嗽，可以去附近的社区诊所看一看。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: clin(倾斜、躺下，病人躺下看病的地方) + -ic -> 诊所，医务室。
